reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises if the 'stale numbers' cannot be isolated cleanly. If the deletion of a file causes a cascading failure in the family table row count or breaks the arxiv-deep ledger coverage logic, the minimal patch assumption collapses. In such a regime, attempting a localized fix would introduce severe leakage, corrupting the structural integrity of the index. The cross-layer veto mandates halting the patch and triggering a full re-derivation of the index schema if the delta exceeds the bounds of simple numerical substitution.
